subject: ISV Instrumentation Council — kickoff, charter, and short-term deliverables
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
To: Randall Moss <randall@llmtoolkit.ai>, Priya Desai <priya@promptforge.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ISV Instrumentation Council — kickoff, charter, and short-term deliverables

Hi Randall / Priya —

Thanks again for agreeing to join an informal "ISV Instrumentation Council". The goal is simple: align on a minimal cross-ISV runtime telemetry and SDK contract so integrators and our customers get consistent tracing, token-level cost signals, and lightweight prompt-change hooks. That will make co-signed integrations (and troubleshooting) much faster for everyone.

Attached is a very short draft charter (ISCouncil-charter-draft-v1.pdf) and a starter telemetry field map (telemetry-field-map.xlsx). Proposed agenda for the kickoff call (30–45 mins):
- Quick intros (3–5m)
- Council charter & success metrics (5m)
- Telemetry priorities (tracing, token-cost, model-variant metadata) (10m)
- SDK contract: minimal telemetry/events we can standardize on (10m)
- Next steps & owners (5m)

Can you both confirm availability for Fri 2027-10-01 10:00–10:45 PT? If that doesn't work, suggest two 45m windows next week. Also note any burning items we should add to the agenda (e.g., constraints around PII, data retention, or enterprise telemetry exporters).

Thanks — happy to own scheduling and produce a short one-pager after the call.

Dylan Brooks
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai

Attachments: ISCouncil-charter-draft-v1.pdf (PDF), telemetry-field-map.xlsx (Excel)

From: Randall Moss <randall@llmtoolkit.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>, Priya Desai <priya@promptforge.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 12:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: ISV Instrumentation Council — kickoff, charter, and short-term deliverables

On Tue, Sep 28, 2027 at 09:12 AM Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Randall / Priya —
>
> Thanks again for agreeing to join an informal "ISV Instrumentation Council".

Thanks Dylan — excited to participate. Fri 2027-10-01 10:00 PT works for me. I've skimmed the charter; a couple of high-level asks from LLMToolkit:
- Keep the SDK contract minimal and backwards-compatible (we ship to many enterprise runtimes).
- Include an explicit migration path where we can map vendor-specific telemetry to the council schema.
- Token-cost attribution needs a stable mapping to model variant ids; we've seen drift cause billing confusion.

I'll bring a short slide with our current telemetry keys and an example of how we implement token attribution. Also: happy to share a short RFC in the shared doc before the call.

Randall Moss
Co-founder, LLMToolkit
randall@llmtoolkit.ai

From: Priya Desai <priya@promptforge.io>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>, Randall Moss <randall@llmtoolkit.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 16:47:00 +05:30
Subject: Re: ISV Instrumentation Council — kickoff, charter, and short-term deliverables

Thanks Dylan — I can also do Fri 10:00 PT. A couple of practical items from PromptForge:
- We need clarity on personal data: what telemetry fields are considered PII or user content.
- We already expose prompt-change events in our SDK; we'd like a minimal hook that allows Redwood to opt into receiving anonymized diffs for quality monitoring.
- We have an internal constraint on exporting raw token streams; can the council define a standard pseudonymized token-count schema instead?

I'll add three examples to the telemetry field map and a short note on privacy constraints before the call.

—Priya
Head of Platform, PromptForge

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
To: Randall Moss <randall@llmtoolkit.ai>, Priya Desai <priya@promptforge.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Sofia Alvarez <sofia@observix.com>
Date: Sat, 02 Oct 2027 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: ISV Instrumentation Council — kickoff, charter, and short-term deliverables

Great — locking in Fri 2027-10-01 10:00–10:45 PT. Video invite and agenda link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AqZ-ISVcouncil-charter

Pre-call ask (quick):
- Randall: please drop one slide with your telemetry keys + token attribution example (2 slides max).
- Priya: add the privacy constraints section to the telemetry-field-map and include the pseudonymized token-count example.
- Marissa / Karthik (Redwood): we'll surface our current trace exporters and an abbreviated list of model variant identifiers that we publish in the hosted catalog. Aim is to have these notes in the shared Drive doc by Thu EOD PT so we can run a focused 45m kickoff.

Proposed success metrics for the council's first 60 days (for clarity):
1) Charter agreed & published (one-pager).
2) Shared telemetry field map with mappings for at least 3 ISVs.
3) Reference shim (MIT-licensed) that normalizes token-cost and model-variant metadata in one runtime language (Node or Python) as a quick POC.

If nobody flags faster blockers, I'll send the calendar invite now and upload the charter/field map final draft.

Dylan Brooks
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: ISCouncil-charter-draft-v1.pdf, telemetry-field-map.xlsx
Forwarded links: Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AqZ-ISVcouncil-charter, HubSpot: HS-123456789
